title: Cokret Service Operation DTOs
description: Canonical request and response DTOs migrated from OpenAPI-only operation schemas. OpenAPI components reference this artifact so SDK and conformance tooling use one schema source.

AuthzCheckRequest.description:
ck.authz.check input — single capability decision query. `resource` is
optional because some actions (e.g. `ck.realm.create`, identity-scoped
actions) have no Realm-bound target.

actor_id.description: Subject DID whose authorization is being checked.

resource.description: Optional resource selector (Realm / Flow / Space / Morph / etc.).

context.description: Optional decision context — claim presentations, frontier reference, request metadata.

decision.description:
`allow` / `deny` are terminal decisions. `quarantine` / `require_review`
are policy-server-mediated soft outcomes (the request enters async
review). `soft_fail` is a transient retryable failure; callers MUST
treat it as fail-closed for high-risk actions unless a profile
explicitly allows local pending behavior.

freshness_state.description: Frontier freshness classification for revocation-sensitive decisions; see zh/authz/capabilities.md §18.2.

last_known_frontier_age_ms.description: Age of the newest revocation/auth frontier evidence used for this decision. Present when freshness_state is stale or unknown.

anchorer_status.description: Coarse status of the anchorer/frontier source used to diagnose stale or unknown revocation freshness.

reason_code.description: Registered reason code. High-risk stale or unknown revocation freshness returns revocation_freshness_unknown.

retry_after_ms.description: Set when `decision=soft_fail` or `freshness_state ∈ {stale,unknown}`; client SHOULD back off this amount before retry.

obligations.description: Policy server obligations (challenge / rate_limit / drop_attachment) the caller MUST satisfy before the action proceeds.

blob_ref.description: Target blob. MUST be a content-addressed ref or visible blob metadata id.

realm_id.description: Realm binding for Realm-owned blobs. Servers MUST include the same realm_id in the presign envelope and reject mismatches with blob metadata; only deployment-public/global blobs may omit this field.

max_age_seconds.description: Client-requested TTL upper bound. Server clamps to the smaller of this value, the issuing grant's `blob_presign_max_ttl_seconds` constraint, and the deployment-level cap.

purpose.description: Intended rendering / download mode. Servers MAY apply purpose-specific Content-Disposition or rate limits.

url.description: Fully-qualified URL clients can pass to browser primitives. Contains the `presign` query parameter, `blob_ref`, and a presign envelope bound to `realm_id` for Realm-owned blobs.

expires_at.description: Server-determined expiry; SHOULD be earlier than `now() + max_age_seconds`.

type.description: Backend binding type identifier (livekit / cokret-native / etc.).

backend_token.description: Opaque to Cokret protocol; type-specific (e.g. LiveKit JWT).

participant_identity.description: SFU-local short handle, scope `(call_id, focus_id, sfu_did)`. UUIDv7-form rtc_participant typed ID.

messages.description: DeviceMessageEnvelope items; not Event Envelope objects. Renamed from `events` to remove the misleading appearance that this endpoint serves the durable Event timeline.

did_method.description: DID method discriminator (e.g. web, webvh, key). Verifiers dispatch method-specific validation from this value and the did prefix.

seq.description: Optional method sequence number when the DID method exposes one.

prev_event_digest.description: Optional previous operation hash / key-log head, when required by the DID method.

operation.description: DID method-specific raw operation object. This is not a generic JSON Patch and MUST be validated by the selected DID method adapter.

policy_context.description: Optional resolver / registry policy context bound into authorization and audit.

seq.description: New method sequence number when available.

discovery_state.description: Signed ck.{kind}.discovery payload, including its proof.

governance_proof.description: Signature proof by the resource governance key, equivalent strength to announce.discovery_state.proof.

withdrawal_ref.description: Directory-local audit reference for the withdrawal; not a registered ck:<kind> typed ID.

EphemeralSubmitResponse.description:
Result of ck.ephemeral.send. `accepted=true` means the Sync Service
admitted the short-lived signal into its ephemeral fanout path. No
Event ID, actor_seq, Anchor frontier, or durable receipt is minted.

dispatched_to.description: Optional implementation hint for fanout recipients queued locally.

EventGetResponse.description: Result of ck.events.get — a single Event Envelope with optional visibility / receipt hints.

visibility.description: Caller-visible policy hint for this event (history visibility class, E2EE envelope class).

receipts.description: Event batch receipts witnessing this event, if visible.

realms.description: Filter by Realm IDs. UNION within, intersection with `actors[]`.

actors.description: Filter by Actor DIDs. UNION within, intersection with `realms[]`.

before.description: Return events strictly older than this cursor position (exclusive).

after.description: Return events strictly newer than this cursor position (exclusive).

order.description: Same semantics as the GET form `order` query parameter.

EventsQueryResponse.description:
Result of ck.events.query (GET form) and ck.events.query_post (POST/body
form). Ordering follows the "近邻先返回" rule unless `order` was
explicitly set on the request; see service-http-binding.md §3.3.3.

prev_cursor.description: Absolute-direction cursor toward older events; pass to next request's `before=`.

next_cursor.description: Absolute-direction cursor toward newer events; pass to next request's `after=`.

has_more.description: True if more events remain in the `prev_cursor` (older) direction; SHOULD ignore `next_cursor` direction (subscribe / poll instead).

EventsResolveRequest.description: ck.events.resolve request body. At least one of event_ids or event_digests MUST be non-empty.

EventsResolveResponse.description: ck.events.resolve result. `events[]` and `missing[]` plus optional `unauthorized[]` form a partition of the requested set.

missing.description: IDs / hashes that were requested but do not exist or are not visible (indistinguishable per visibility rules).

unauthorized.description: Optional split of missing into a separately-named bucket when policy explicitly distinguishes auth failure from non-existence.

EventsSubmitResponse.description:
Result of ck.events.submit. Tracks per-event acceptance / duplication /
rejection along with the post-write frontier and an optional barrier
cursor for read-your-writes.

accepted.description: Event IDs that entered the accepted set (including idempotent re-accepts of identical bodies).

duplicate.description: Event IDs whose canonical bytes matched a prior accepted event (idempotent no-op).

quarantine.description: Event IDs deferred to async / human verification.

actor_frontier.description: Per-actor frontier after this submit (subset of full frontier visible to caller).

realm_frontier.description: Per-Realm frontier after this submit. (Renamed from the legacy 'space_frontier' field name — in v1 the replication/security boundary is the Realm, not an in-Realm Space container; the legacy name is forbidden on the current wire.)

cursor.description: Optional barrier cursor (purpose=barrier) bound to the most recently accepted event.

IdentityGetDocumentResponse.description: Result of ck.identity.get_document — current DID Document plus normalized view hints.

did_document.description: Raw DID Core document with W3C field names preserved.

normalized_view.description:
Optional Cokret normalized principal view (snake_case) — derived
projection only, NOT a re-publishable DID Document. See
zh/identity/identity-did.md §6.

method_evidence.description: Method-specific proof material (e.g. did:webvh history head, witness signatures).

PolicyCheckRequest.description: ck.policy.check input bound to a Realm authorization context.

PolicyCheckResponse.description: Result of ck.policy.check — signed decision bound to authorization, policy, and membership frontier hashes.

bound_to.description: Request context covered by the policy decision signature. Allows receivers to verify a forwarded decision without guessing transcript fields.

auth_state_digest.description: Accepted authorization state hash used when producing the decision.

policy_frontier_digest.description: Policy source frontier / digest used when producing the decision.

membership_frontier_digest.description: Membership / role frontier digest used when producing the decision.

kid.description: DID URL of the policy server verification method.

sig.description: Detached signature over the policy decision transcript.

agent_key_authorization_ref.description:
`ck.profile.agent_auth.v1` overlay (CKP-0008 §4.6). Event ref of the accepted
`ck.agent.key.authorize` that authorized the runtime key. REQUIRED when
`proof.proof_kind="agent_key_proof"`; MUST be omitted for human session grants.

agent_scope_request.description:
`ck.profile.agent_auth.v1` overlay (CKP-0008 §4.6). Narrowing hints for the
issued session scope; the server still intersects with the agent's accepted
capability grants and Realm policy. REQUIRED when `proof.proof_kind="agent_key_proof"`;
MUST be omitted for human session grants. `track_names` is a request-side
narrowing field only — the materialized session grant MUST express track scope
via the canonical `allowed_tracks` constraint, not via a new `track_names` grant.

proof_kind.description:
`agent_key_proof` selects the `ck.profile.agent_auth.v1` overlay branch (CKP-0008 §4.6).
Implementations MUST route `agent_key_proof` to an independent validator and MUST NOT
fall back to password / OIDC / passkey validators for this branch.

verification_method.description:
`ck.profile.agent_auth.v1` overlay (CKP-0008 §4.6). DID URL of the runtime
signing key (`<agent_principal_id>#<key-fragment>`). REQUIRED when
`proof_kind="agent_key_proof"`; the DID component MUST bit-identically equal
`principal_id` after stripping the fragment / query — otherwise the endpoint
returns `verification_method_principal_mismatch`. MUST be omitted for human
proof kinds.

allOf.description:
Machine-enforceable agent_key_proof branch selector. When `proof.proof_kind` is
`agent_key_proof`, the request MUST carry the `ck.profile.agent_auth.v1` overlay
fields (`agent_key_authorization_ref`, `agent_scope_request`, `proof.verification_method`);
when it is any other enum value, those fields MUST be absent. SDKs and server-side
validators MUST reject violations at schema-validation time, not at proof-validator
time.

session_grant.description: Short-lived bearer/session grant bound to the requested principal, device and audience.

scope_details.description:
`ck.profile.agent_auth.v1` overlay (CKP-0008 §4.6). Materialized narrow scope
actually granted to the agent runtime session, after intersecting `agent_scope_request`
with capability grants and Realm policy. Present iff the request was the
`proof.proof_kind="agent_key_proof"` branch; absent for human session grants.

SnapshotHeadResponse.description: Result of ck.snapshot.head — a signed snapshot pointer for fast bootstrap. snapshot_ref is an external pointer and MUST equal the Snapshot manifest id. created_by, created_at, and authority_binding are part of the signed manifest transcript (see schemas/snapshot.schema.json#/properties/signature x-canonical-bytes-include) and MUST be returned to verifiers.

snapshot_ref.description: External pointer to the Snapshot manifest; MUST equal schemas/snapshot.schema.json#/properties/id.

created_by.description: DID of the snapshot issuer; bound by the manifest signature transcript.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in 'Z' when the manifest was sealed; bound by the manifest signature transcript.

authority_binding.description: Snapshot issuer authority evidence bound by the manifest signature transcript; mirrors schemas/snapshot.schema.json#/properties/authority_binding.

signature.description: Detached proof of the snapshot manifest; verifier MUST validate against signer's verification method.

ActorDid.description: Bare DID used as a Cokret actor/principal identifier. DID URL fragments belong in verification_method, not actor_id/principal_id.

allOf.description:
Actor-supplied ck.events.submit input envelope. It reuses the base Event
shape for actor intent fields but forbids reducer-managed accepted-output
projections such as actor_kind and effective_scope. Services stamp those
fields only after accept and expose them on read/query/sync envelopes.

frontier.description:
Either an actor frontier (`{actor_id, actor_seq, event_id}`) or a
Realm frontier (`{realm_id, anchor_id, state_root, hlc?}`) shape
depending on which selector was passed; servers MUST NOT leak
frontiers across visibility boundaries.

EventsFrontierAnonymousHealthResponse.description: Anonymous health ck.events.frontier response. MUST NOT include actor_seq_upper_bounds, receipts, frontier details, or service signature material.

frontier_root.description: Opaque hash commitment suitable for liveness / freshness checks.

cache_expires_at.description: Earliest time until which clients SHOULD reuse this anonymous health response. Anonymous health responses MUST impose at least a 60 second cache/backoff window; clients MUST treat shorter values as 60 seconds.

retry_after_ms.description: Minimum retry delay for anonymous health probes when the service wants explicit polling backoff. Anonymous health responses MUST impose at least a 60 second cache/backoff window.

EventsFrontierFederationPeerResponse.description: Federation peer ck.events.frontier response. Requires S2S signed trust-domain headers.

frontier.description: Realm frontier visible to the authenticated federation peer.

frontier_root.description: Hash commitment returned for federation_peer and anonymous_health peer_role.

actor_seq_upper_bounds.description: Per-actor sequence upper bounds returned for federation_peer peer_role.

signature.description: Service signature over the frontier response when peer_role=federation_peer.

EventsSubmitBatchRequest.description: Batch ck.events.submit request used by account clients.

FederationServiceBindingRef.description:
Request-level service binding snapshot carried by federation
service-to-service ck.events.submit calls. This is metadata for the
receiver to verify the sender's delivery decision; client writes omit it.

title.description: Derived display title from plaintext-visible Flow metadata.title; null when metadata is encrypted or hidden from the service profile.

summary.description: Derived display summary from plaintext-visible Flow metadata.summary; null when metadata is encrypted or hidden from the service profile.

board_space_id.description: Derived board Space id from ck.component.flow.position.v1; not canonical Flow object state.

list_space_id.description: Derived list Space id from ck.component.flow.position.v1; not canonical Flow object state.

rank.description: Derived rank within list_space_id from ck.component.flow.position.v1.

kind.description: Space kind such as `board`, `list`, `folder`, or a profile-registered kind.

ServiceDid.description: Bare DID identifying a service endpoint.

SnapshotBootstrap.description: Optional ck.events.query acceleration hint for federation pull / backfill. snapshot_ref is an external pointer and MUST equal the Snapshot manifest id. Verifier MUST validate signature, state_digest, snapshot_frontier, chunk digests, created_by, created_at, and authority_binding before use (manifest fields are bound by the manifest signature transcript — see schemas/snapshot.schema.json).

snapshot_ref.description: External pointer to the Snapshot manifest; MUST equal schemas/snapshot.schema.json#/properties/id.

created_by.description: DID of the snapshot issuer; bound by the manifest signature transcript.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in 'Z' when the manifest was sealed; bound by the manifest signature transcript.

authority_binding.description: Snapshot issuer authority evidence bound by the manifest signature transcript; mirrors schemas/snapshot.schema.json#/properties/authority_binding.
